_comment: LRAUV, real xdyn dynamics, drift-only: no Guidance/Control feedback
loop. The propeller is held at a fixed near-idle command (1.5708
rad/s, ~15 RPM) rather than 0, since the propeller's Kt(J)/Kq(J)
curve divides by commanded rpm and a literal 0 crashes xdyn.
propeller(rpm) is in radians/second despite the key name.
